name: from_iter_exact
declaration: unsafe fn from_iter_exact (iter : impl Iterator < Item = T > , len : usize) -> Rc < [T] >
documentation:
Constructs an `Rc<[T]>` from an iterator known to be of a certain size.

 Behavior is undefined should the size be wrong.
rules: For safety, `len` must equal the number of items yielded by `iter`; otherwise, behavior is undefined.
